meta.name: antinet-security-scan
meta.description: 对进入系统的文件或 URL 执行安全与合规扫描，输出 pass/reject 判定与扫描报告，作为所有文档处理的强制前置关卡。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描文件和链接，给出安全合规的放行或拒绝结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你需要在上传文件或打开链接之前，先确认它们没有安全问题。
copy.tagline_en: Scan files and links, then issue pass/reject security report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to vet files or links for safety before they enter your system.

howto.what: 收到文件或网址时，Claude 会先执行安全与合规扫描，而不是直接处理：查黑名单、验证许可、探测文件类型，输出 pass/reject 判定、扫描报告与追踪 ID。
howto.when: 当文件或 URL 进入系统、需要先过安检时触发；可用本地文件路径或外部网址，也可用 policy_ref 换规则。

say.text: 扫一下这个链接 https://example.com，先查域名黑名单。
say.note: 网址会被解析域名并核对黑名单。

say.text: 扫描 /data/in/contract.docx，标注许可校验状态。
say.note: 会先验证 OA 文档许可，再给判定。

howto.what_en: When Claude receives a file or URL, it runs a security and compliance check: domain blacklist, OA license, file type; then outputs pass/reject, report, and trace ID.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a file or URL enters the system, as the first gate. Callable with a local file path or external URL; optional policy_ref switches compliance rules.

say_en.text: Please scan this PDF: /tmp/example.pdf, and return pass or reject.
say_en.note: Claude detects the file type first, then gives the verdict and report.

say_en.text: Scan this link https://example.com and check the domain blacklist first.
say_en.note: The URL is resolved and checked against the blacklist.

say_en.text: Scan /data/in/contract.docx and report the license check status.
say_en.note: It validates the OA document license before deciding.
